text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rumble rumble rumble!!)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oooooh!? What's the deal with that 
boulder!?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I don't know...! I mean, just run for 
now!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Rewinding back a few hours—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Did you discover a suspicious cave?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That's it! So, I figured I'd go take a 
quick peek! Who knows, might be somethin' 
real good there!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"That's right. You never know what might 
happen. And it'd be hard to get in touch 
if you were alone, Senpai."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oh? So you're comin' with me after all!? 
Well, can't be helped then—we'll split the 
treasure fifty-fifty!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What was with that giant boulder just 
now?! Tamamo-senpai, this place really is 
bad news!
choice_data_list: Let's turn back while we still can!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm not givin' up! Think about it, if 
there's traps, there's gotta be treasure 
too—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Tamamo-senpai!! Right there! The 
color of the floor is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (KER-CLUNK!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Swish! Whir, whir, whir!)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Nowaaaah!! Something came flying this 
waaaay!!
choice_data_list: Not good, they're heading toward City!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...! Just this much—!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...You gotta be kidding me. How many times 
did you change your posture in that split 
second?
choice_data_list:
To think she could dodge everything just 
by striking poses!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, that reaction speed is unreal. 
To be able to switch poses so sharply, 
over and over...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Still, aren't we finally at the goal?! 
There's even something that looks like a 
treasure chest over there!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Man, what's with that giant pit? The only 
way across is that tiny little path down 
the middle. It's barely even one foot 
wide, ya know?"
choice_data_list:
Walking across that might be next to 
impossible...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: —I'm heading out.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wait, hold on, aren't you scared at all?! 
Walking off so casually!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I mean, what even is that... That, that's 
almost like—!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: It's a runway~~!!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, what's with all this 
excitement?"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Huuuhm, in the end, all we found was a 
single old arcade coin. Why set up traps 
for just that~...?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
There's no such thing as a free lunch, 
after all. ...I'm tired. Shall we head 
back?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Still, though—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That's our top model for ya, City!! I 
really gotta hand it to ya!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Yes?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You dodged everything with such incredible 
agility! Ahh, I'm totally smitten~!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Hello. Well, I suppose it's just an 
occupational habit—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, you're working hard every 
single day. Lookin' at how perfect you 
are, it's impossible not to notice!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: —Huh?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Normally that's impossible! You can't pull 
that off with such a cool face!
choice_data_list:
Your unwavering mental strength was 
incredible too!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Totally! I bet every single bit of that'll 
become a weapon for your running, too.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...! Do you really, really think so!?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
That everything I've done actually meant 
something—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Well, not like I'd know, though.
choice_data_list: Even after I praised you this much.../!?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ain't got a clue. In the first place, what 
you make into your weapon is up to you.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
“...... That's true. Depending on how you 
look at it, I'm sure—”

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
(..."If you didn't work hard every day," 
huh? Well, maybe it does come in handy 
sometimes.)
